authority: Prospective design rationale only; no empirical efficacy or qualification claim.
confound_to_report: Selectivewarm and fullwarm differ in inactive computation and available learner feedback; this is not a pure persistence-only causal contrast.
decision: Register selectivewarm as primary persistent arm before development or heldout generation; retain fullwarm as ninth paid-feedback/state-retention control.
finding: Full-warm runs native forecasts and updates on every public observation plus temporal/frequency/detector work. With the unchanged native learner and matched complete input history, no avoided native work explains a prospective CPU advantage over always-on native.
primary_statistical_rule: Unchanged five Holm-corrected one-sided paired seed-block tests; objective/quality-margin/CPU versus native, objective/quality-margin versus temporal.
review_type: read-only source reasoning, no measured result
